findings.evidence: Cool appearance drives obstruction misses while shadow and sensor-noise appearances drive visible false stops
findings.successor_dependency: Use fresh independent base scenes and predeclared appearance-invariance training rather than more thresholds

findings.evidence: Cable, tool, and compression families contribute most threshold-0.20 obstruction misses
findings.successor_dependency: Replace pixel-fill proxies with physically shaped renders spanning material, edge, depth, and transparency variation

findings.evidence: All 75 targets have nonpositive local visible-versus-obstruction separation margins
findings.successor_dependency: Retain target-balanced gates and require positive held-out local margins before evaluation
